quantities.label: c² = B/ρ
quantities.meaning: substrate sound speed — at the isostatic margin the relaxed shear modulus vanishes while the bulk modulus B stays finite, leaving exactly one elastic (longitudinal sound) wave, the defining acoustic signature of a fluid.
